# STREAM provenance

Unmodified `stream.c` and its licence are vendored from
https://github.com/jeffhammond/STREAM at commit
`6703f7504a38a8da96b353cadafa64d3c2d7a2d3`.

SHA-256 of `stream.c`:
`c388924eb140fda95f534cdb808ae7f1f8ebb18da41d8aec1b512a3c8d303c9b`.

Original author: John D. McCalpin. The upstream licence and publication
conditions apply independently of Octobench's GPL-3.0 licence.

Octobench records array sizing, compiler flags, validation, and timing
calibration. Reports conservatively label measurements as STREAM-derived:
automatic cache-size checks alone do not certify full STREAM Run Rules
compliance. See https://www.cs.virginia.edu/stream/ref.html.
